note: Every row was read from the vendor's own pages on this date, except SEOptimer, whose site answers automated requests with a refusal: that row is the one read on 2026-10-08 and the page says so. Prices are US dollar list prices for one person. A thing the page did not state is recorded as not stated, never guessed. Nothing here was measured by running the rival's software.

tools.name: SEO PowerSuite Enterprise
tools.kind: a desktop suite for Windows, Apple and Linux
tools.white_label: white-label SEO reports, fully customizable report templates, saving and emailing reports in PDF and HTML, and automated report scheduling and delivery
tools.sold: the Enterprise plan is $599 a year billed yearly; the Professional plan at $349 a year does not list white-label reports

tools.name: Netpeak Spider
tools.kind: a desktop crawler for Windows and macOS
tools.white_label: its Spider page says the white-label feature generates a website SEO audit report in PDF featuring your company's logo, contacts and recommendations
tools.sold: $20 a month, cancel anytime, after a 3 day free trial

tools.name: Sitebulb Pro
tools.kind: a desktop app for Windows or Mac, with a separate cloud product
tools.white_label: the Pro plan lists customised PDF reports, scheduled audits and audit comparisons; its pricing page does not use the words white label, and a customer quote on its features page calls the PDFs white-label
tools.sold: Pro is $425 a year for 1 user; the Lite plan at $180 a year does not list customised PDF reports

tools.name: SE Ranking with the Agency Pack
tools.white_label: the Agency Pack add-on lists white label for platform and reporting, 30 client seats and unlimited scheduled reporting
tools.sold: the Agency Pack is $69 a month on annual billing only, on top of a plan: Core is $129 a month, or $103.20 a month billed annually

tools.name: Semrush with the Pro Report add-on
tools.white_label: the Pro Report add-on lists branding and white-labeling, delivery at a specific time and sharing by link
tools.sold: the Pro Report add-on is $20 a month on top of a plan: the SEO plan is $139 a month, or $117.33 a month billed annually

tools.name: Sitechecker
tools.white_label: it has a page titled White Label SEO Tool for Audits and Reports, and the pages read do not say which plan unlocks white label
tools.sold: plans run from $99 a month to $449 a month, with a 14 day free trial and no card needed

tools.name: SEOptimer
tools.white_label: Pro and Max name white label PDF reporting, and its feature breakdown lists a white label custom domain and report templates
tools.sold: Pro is $39 a month and Max is $59 a month (read 8 October 2026, because its site refuses automated requests)
